name: the-space-dots-follow-the-active-space
description: A switch through many spaces keeps the active dot inside the visible part of the space dots bar. The fixture has 20 spaces, so the dots outgrow the bar. Nineteen next-space presses carry the active dot past the right edge to the last space, and seventeen previous-space presses bring it back past the left edge. After every press the active dot's box must lie inside the bar's box, and at the end the page itself must not scroll sideways.

actions.expression: location.href

actions.note: ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.dotscroll'); if (!b) return 'NOBAR'; return b.scrollWidth > b.clientWidth ? 'overflows' : 'flat:' + b.scrollWidth + '/' + b.clientWidth; })()
actions.note: the control: without overflow there is nothing to follow

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.dotscroll'); const a = b && b.querySelector('.sdot.active'); if (!a) return 'NOACTIVE'; const br = b.getBoundingClientRect(); const ar = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return (ar.left >= br.left - 0.5 && ar.right <= br.right + 0.5 ? 'visible:' : 'hidden:') + a.dataset.spaceIndex; })()
actions.note: every press below repeats this check, so the bar is proven after each switch, not only at the turns
